header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open Speech Studio
header.desc: Free speech recognition for everyone with a local AI on your own PC. 1 installer file. No hassle.

dictate.title: Dictate anywhere
dictate.desc: Dictate text directly in any application via an overlay. Use CTRL+Windows or CTRL+SHIFT+Space to do speech-to-text anywhere in your OS.

transcribe.title: Transcribe audio files
transcribe.desc: Transcribe audio files with parallel processing. Multiple files simultaneously, fast and accurate.

meetings.title: Record meetings
meetings.desc: Record meetings and transcribe in real-time. Automatic minutes and summaries.

gpu.title: GPU acceleration
gpu.desc: CUDA GPU acceleration for faster results. Optimal use of your hardware for maximum performance.

local.title: 100% local
local.desc: Everything runs locally on your own computer. Your data never leaves your PC. No cloud, no subscription, no limits.

tech.title: Whisper AI + Tauri + Rust
tech.desc: Built with OpenAI Whisper AI for speech recognition, Tauri for the desktop app and Rust for the backend. Open source.
